skill_name: Describe the reasons why human brains are better at recognizing patterns than computers
workflow: Humans brains are better at recognizing patterns than computers because they are able to process complex, multidimensional information and draw on prior experience and knowledge to better determine what is meaningful and what isn’t. Computers can crunch huge amounts of data, but they lack the intuition and contextual understanding of humans. Human brains also have greater flexibility when it comes to pattern recognition.
